sentences.en: So if you're one of those people who hasn't found the perfect physical activity yet - here are some things to think about which might help you make the right decision for you.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是那种还没找到最适合自己的体育锻炼方式的人——这里有一些值得思考的因素，或许能帮你为自己做出正确的选择。

sentences.en: The first question to ask yourself is whether you would enjoy training in a gym.
sentences.zh: 你要问自己的第一个问题是：你是否喜欢在健身房里锻炼？

sentences.en: Many people are put off by the idea of having to fit a visit to the gym into their busy day - you often have to go very early or late as some gyms can get very crowded.
sentences.zh: 很多人一想到要把去健身房的时间安排进自己忙碌的日程中就望而却步——你常常不得不很早或很晚去，因为有些健身房会非常拥挤。

sentences.en: But with regular training you'll see a big.
sentences.zh: 但通过规律训练，你将在相对较短的时间内看到显著效果。

sentences.en: difference in a relatively short space of time.
sentences.zh: 差异会在相对较短的时间内显现出来。

sentences.en: Running has become incredibly popular in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，跑步变得极其流行。

sentences.en: That's probably got a lot to do with the fact that it's a very accessible form of exercise - anyone can run - even if you can only run a few metres to begin with.
sentences.zh: 这很可能与跑步是一种极易开展的运动形式密切相关——任何人都可以跑步——哪怕你一开始只能跑几米。

sentences.en: But make sure you get the right shoes - it's worth investing in a high quality pair and they don't come cheap.
sentences.zh: 但务必选购合适的跑鞋——值得投资一双高品质的跑鞋，而且它们价格不菲。

sentences.en: Another great thing about running is that you can do It at any time of day or night - the only thing that may stop you is snow and ice.
sentences.zh: 跑步另一大优点是：你可以在一天中的任何时间（包括夜间）进行——唯一可能阻碍你的，大概只有冰雪天气。

sentences.en: Swimming iS another really good way to build fitness.
sentences.zh: 游泳是提升体能的另一种极佳方式。

sentences.en: What attracts many people is that you can swim in an indoor pool at any time of year.
sentences.zh: 吸引许多人的地方在于：你全年任何时候都可以在室内泳池游泳。

sentences.en: On the other hand, it can be quite boring or solitary it's hard to chat to people while you're swimming lengths.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，游泳可能相当枯燥或孤独——你在泳道中来回游动时很难与他人交谈。

sentences.en: Cycling has become almost as popular as running in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，骑自行车的受欢迎程度几乎与跑步不相上下。

sentences.en: That's probably because as well as improving their fitness, many people say being out in the fresh air in a park or in the countryside can be fun, provided the conditions are right, of course - only fanatics go out in the wind and rain!
sentences.zh: 这很可能是因为：除了增强体能外，许多人表示，在公园或乡村的新鲜空气中骑行充满乐趣——当然，前提是天气条件适宜；只有狂热者才会顶着风雨外出！

sentences.en: Yoga is a good choice for those of you looking for exercise which focuses on developing both a healthy mind and body.
sentences.zh: 瑜伽是那些希望兼顾身心健康人士的理想选择。

sentences.en: It's a good way of building strength and with the right instructor, there's 015 less chance of hurting yourself than with other more active sports.
sentences.zh: 它是一种增强力量的有效方式；而且，若有合格教练指导，相比其他更剧烈的运动，你受伤的风险更低。

sentences.en: But don't expect to find it easy it can be surprisingly challenging, especially for people who aren't very flexible.
sentences.zh: 但别指望它很容易——它其实出人意料地具有挑战性，尤其对柔韧性较差的人而言。

sentences.en: Getting a personal trainer is a good way to start your fitness programme.
sentences.zh: 聘请私人教练是开启健身计划的良好方式。

sentences.en: Obviously there can be significant costs involved.
sentences.zh: 显然，这可能涉及相当可观的费用。

sentences.en: But if you've got someone there to encourage you and help you achieve your goals, you're less likely to give up.
sentences.zh: 但若有人在旁鼓励你、助你实现目标，你就更不容易放弃。

sentences.en: Make sure you get someone with a recognised qualification, though, or you could do yourself permanent damage.
sentences.zh: 不过，请务必选择持有公认资质认证的教练，否则你可能会造成永久性损伤。

sentences.en: Whatever you do, don't join a gym unless you're sure you'll make good use of it.
sentences.zh: 无论你选择何种方式，除非确定自己会充分利用，否则切勿加入健身房。

sentences.en: So many people waste lots of money by signing up for membership and then hardly ever go.
sentences.zh: 太多人因签约会员后却极少前往而白白浪费大量金钱。

sentences.en: What happens to their good intentions?
sentences.zh: 他们的良好意愿究竟怎么了？

sentences.en: I don't think people suddenly stop caring about improving their fitness, or decide they have more important things to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们并非突然不再关心自身健康水平的提升，也并非突然觉得有比健身更重要的事要做。

sentences.en: I think people lose interest when they don't think they're making enough progress.
sentences.zh: 我认为，当人们觉得自己进步不够明显时，便会逐渐失去兴趣。

sentences.en: That's when they give up hope and & stop believing they'll ever achieve their goals.
sentences.zh: 此时，他们便放弃希望，并停止相信自己终将达成目标。

sentences.en: Also, what people sometimes don't realise when they start is that it takes a lot of determination and hard work to keep training week after week and lots of people don't have that kind of commitment.
sentences.zh: 此外，人们刚开始时往往没有意识到：要持续坚持每周训练，需要极大的决心和辛勤付出；而许多人并不具备这种长期投入的承诺精神。

sentences.en: One thing you can do to help yourself is to set manageable goals - be realistic and don't & & push yourself too far.
sentences.zh: 你可以采取的一个自我激励方法是：设定切实可行的目标——保持现实态度，切勿过度勉强自己。

sentences.en: Some people advise writing goals down, but I think it's better to have a flexible approach.
sentences.zh: 有人建议把目标写下来，但我认为采用灵活的方式更好。

sentences.en: Give yourself a really nice treat every time you reach one of your goals.
sentences.zh: 每当你达成一个目标时，都要给自己一份真正美好的奖励。

sentences.en: And don't get too upset if you experience setbacks - it's a journey - there are bound to be difficulties along the way.
sentences.zh: 若遭遇挫折，也不必过于沮丧——这是一段旅程，途中难免遇到困难。
